name: seq

name: vim
note: vim on a big file, scrolled down from the top
command: seq -f 'line %g of a big file for vim to scroll' 1 20000 > /tmp/scroll-bench.txt && vim -u NONE -c 'set mouse=a' /tmp/scroll-bench.txt

name: nvim
command: seq -f 'line %g of a big file for nvim to scroll' 1 20000 > /tmp/scroll-bench.txt && nvim --clean /tmp/scroll-bench.txt
